name: @0xinfrax/mpc-sdk
description: InfraX MPC SDK — lightweight independent client for the MPC wallet microservice (email-based key-shard wallets). Wallet module (sendCode/register/recover/status/listWallets/createWallet) + Session module (unlock/lock/status). E-4④: single email → 1:N sub-wallets with walletId dimension. No dependency on infrax-dk.
author: InfraX
